extracted.name: Seared Sea Scallops
extracted.description: These tender seared scallops with a delicate herb crust make an elegant main course.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, mix together flour, salt, oregano, thyme and lemon pepper. Roll scallops in flour mixture until lightly coated on all sides.

Heat olive oil in a skillet or frying pan over high heat. Add 4 scallops to the pan and sear on all sides (about 2 minutes for each side). After turning scallops, add 1 tablespoon parsley and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Remove scallops from pan and place on a plate in the oven to keep warm until ready to serve.
Repeat until remaining scallops are cooked, tossing each batch with parsley and lemon juice.
